title: Place an order from the cart and reach the order detail view
description: This verifies that a customer can confirm a cart purchase end-to-end, see the cart clear, and land on the new order detail screen.

steps.description: Open a shop with available items
Add at least one item to the cart
Confirm the purchase in the dialog
Verify the cart is cleared and the new order detail view is displayed

title: Accept an incoming order from the shopkeeper dashboard
description: This verifies that a shopkeeper can open the dashboard, inspect an incoming order, and accept it so the status changes to accepted.

steps.description: Verify the order status changes to accepted

title: Mark an accepted order as delivered
description: This verifies that a shopkeeper can complete an accepted order by marking it delivered from the dashboard.

steps.description: Verify the order status changes to delivered

title: Review the cart before placing an order
description: This verifies that a customer can open the cart, review selected items and total, and proceed to the order confirmation flow.

steps.description: Open a shop with available items
Add multiple items to the cart
Verify the selected items and order total are displayed

title: Cancel a placed order before it is accepted
description: This verifies that a customer can cancel an order while it is still placed and that the order leaves the active flow afterward.

steps.description: Verify the order is removed from the active flow

title: View the order confirmation dialog before submitting a purchase
description: This verifies that placing an order first shows a confirmation dialog with the shop and order total before the purchase is finalized.

steps.description: Open a shop with available items
Add at least one item to the cart
Verify a purchase confirmation dialog is displayed with the shop and total

title: Reject an incoming order with a reason
description: This verifies that a shopkeeper can reject an order only after providing a reason and that the order status changes to rejected.

steps.description: Verify the order status changes to rejected

title: See live active orders and open an order for tracking
description: This verifies that a customer can open the active orders screen, see current orders, and inspect a single order's live tracking view.

steps.description: Verify the active orders list and the order tracking details are displayed

title: Watch an active order update status in real time
description: This verifies that a customer can keep the active order view open and see the order status change as the order progresses.

steps.description: Wait for the order status to update
Verify the updated order status is displayed in the active flow

title: See a live incoming orders stream on the shopkeeper dashboard
description: This verifies that the shopkeeper dashboard shows incoming orders in real time and allows opening an order for details.

steps.description: Verify incoming orders are displayed in the live stream

title: Review delivered orders in order history
description: This verifies that a customer can open order history and review past orders after live tracking has completed.

steps.description: Verify delivered orders are displayed in the order history view

title: Keep customer and shopkeeper views in sync during order progression
description: This verifies that a status change made by the shopkeeper is reflected in the customer's active order view without leaving the page.

steps.description: Open the same order from the incoming orders stream
Verify the customer's active order view reflects the accepted status

title: Prevent cancellation after an order has been accepted
description: This verifies that a customer cannot cancel an order once it has moved beyond the placed state.

steps.description: Verify the cancel action is unavailable or disabled
